program_solutions:
(rule!
  (foldl (lambda (p out)
           (let ((nr (+ (first p) 1)) (nc (+ (second p) 1)))
             (if (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))
                 (set-cell out nr nc 6)
                 out)))
         (paint-cells g (find-color g 6) 0)
         (find-color g 6)))
